title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Enters Raccoon City For Wild Video Game Crossover
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has become a force to be reckoned with in the anime world, and for good reason. The titular elf has become a fan-favorite thanks to leading the charge in a story that is quite different from many other anime stories in the world today.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Great Anime Side Characters Who Secretly Stole The Show
content: The anime industry has produced many great series with amazing casts of main characters . These main characters are what essentially define an anime’s narrative. However, having only the main characters at the center all the time, despite how compelling they are, can become repetitive and boring.

title: Lupin The 3rd Voice Actor Yukiko Nikaido Dies at 87
content: In the anime world, one of the biggest franchises that has been around for decades is Lupin The 3rd , the Gentleman Thief-focused series that routinely returns for new animated series and films.

title: Seven Seas to Release Ultraman by Kazuo Umezz: The Classic Manga Collection
content: Seven Seas announced on Friday that it has licensed Kazuo Umezz's (or Kazuo Umezu ) Ultraman manga. The company will release the series in large-trim hardcover as Ultraman by Kazuo Umezz: The Classic Manga Collection in July 2027.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's Trailer Previews DLC Character Rick Strowd
content: SNK began streaming a trailer on Friday for the Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game , and it previews Rick Strowd: Season 3 will launch on July 23 with six characters joining the roster in the next six months.

title: CUTIE STREET Members Guest Star as Pikachu Idol Group in Pokémon Horizons Anime
content: The staff of the Pokémon: Horizons anime announced on Friday that CUTIE STREET , who perform the current ending theme song "Cute na Kyūtai," will guest star as members of the Cutie Pika Pika idol group in the 147th episode. Cutie Pika Pika first appeared in the CD jacket visual for the ending theme song.
author: ANN

title: Teaser Videos for Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series A Bona Fide Killer Unveiled
content: Korean broadcasting studio MBC released two teaser trailers on July 9 and July 16 for its upcoming live-action series A Bona Fide Killer , offering a closer look at the double life of its assassin protagonist ahead of the series' July 31 debut.
